columns.name: Facility Name
columns.description: Legal name of the licensed Hospice Residence as recorded by IDPH. Often includes the parent hospice program's "DBA" trade name plus a location identifier (e.g., a city or campus name). The same legal entity may also hold a separate Hospice Program license.

columns.name: Address
columns.description: Physical street address of the residence. Suite or building numbers are included where applicable. The address shown is the residence itself, not the parent hospice program's administrative office.

columns.name: City
columns.description: Municipality where the residence is physically located.

columns.name: County
columns.description: Illinois county where the residence is physically located.

columns.name: Zip
columns.description: Five-digit U.S. Postal Service ZIP code of the residence's physical location.

columns.name: Contact Name
columns.description: Primary administrative contact for the residence, designated for IDPH correspondence. Typically the residence administrator or the parent hospice program's director.

columns.name: Phone
columns.description: Main published telephone number for the residence, including area code. Format: (XXX) XXX-XXXX.

columns.name: License Number
columns.description: License number issued by the Illinois Department of Public Health authorizing the building to operate as a Hospice Residence under 210 ILCS 60 and 77 Ill. Adm. Code 280. The residence license is distinct from the parent hospice program's license; the same legal entity will hold separate license numbers for each.

columns.name: Exp. Date
columns.description: Date on which the residence's current IDPH license expires. The residence license must be renewed independently of the parent hospice program license. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
